mentions.name: Word Collector
mentions.description: An offline dictionary that runs in the browser, pulling its data from the open source WordNet dataset and caching it locally as a SQLite database. It is installable as a PWA, and planned features include a study mode for reviewing previously looked-up words, synonyms and antonyms, and multi-language support for language learning.
mentions.source_excerpt: An offline dictionary in your browser. Dictionary is pulled from the open source wordnet dataset and cached in browser as a sqlite database. Installable as a PWA as well. Working on adding a study mode to review words that you’ve looked up in the past to help commit them to memory and adding synonyms and antonyms.
